view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. Multiple forklifts are parked on concrete flooring near tall metal racks filled with stacked boxes and pallets. Yellow safety barriers are placed around equipment. The space is organized for storage and material handling operations.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift with 'REWE' branding is parked on the left side of the frame. It has a black seat and steering column. Its front bumper is visible, and it's positioned near yellow safety blocks. The forklift is stationary and partially obstructed by a stack of black crates.

objects.label: stack of black crates
objects.observation: A tall, rectangular stack of black plastic crates sits on a wooden pallet in the center-left area. Each crate has white labels. The stack is adjacent to a forklift and partially obscures the view of the background racks.

objects.label: metal warehouse rack
objects.observation: High metal racks extend vertically along the right wall, holding multiple levels of cardboard boxes and other goods. The racks have yellow safety rails at the top. They are supported by vertical beams and appear to be bolted to the floor or wall.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: Another orange forklift is parked on the right side, facing slightly toward the camera. It has a black seat and steering column. It is positioned next to a metal rack and partially blocked by a stack of boxes.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: A third orange forklift is visible further back on the right, partially obscured by another forklift and racks. It has a black seat and steering column. It is parked near a stack of cardboard boxes.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic safety barriers are placed on the floor near the forklifts and racks. One is directly beside the first forklift, and others are near the second and third forklifts. They are freestanding and likely used to mark safe zones.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Cardboard boxes are stacked on pallets and on shelves within the warehouse racks. Some are wrapped in clear plastic. They are located behind the forklifts and on upper levels of the racks.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s5-35822", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
